title: On Measures of Biases and Harms in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance, pronoun-name resolution, and stereotypical associations using gendered identity terms and occupations across tasks like coreference resolution, sentiment analysis, text classification, and translation.

Measuring negative associations, sentiment scores, and false positive rates for specific dialects (e.g., AAE) using identity terms in sentiment analysis, question answering, toxicity, and hate speech detection.
Assessing disparities in quality of service, disparagement, and negative sentiment associated with age-related identity terms in sentiment analysis, text classification, and toxicity detection.
Comparing model performance, stereotyping, and negative associations using religious identity terms in natural language inference, question answering, toxicity detection, and hate speech detection.
Evaluating disparagement, stereotyping, and translation errors associated with national identity terms in natural language inference, masked language modeling, and machine translation.
Analyzing toxicity scores, disparagement, and stereotypical associations using identity terms related to disability in toxicity detection and masked language model predictions.
Assessing toxicity, hate speech, and stereotyping in language models using identity terms related to sexual orientation and sexuality.
Evaluating disparagement and stereotyping using identity terms related to political ideologies in toxicity detection, hate speech detection, and autocomplete generation.
Measuring stereotypical associations through identity terms related to socioeconomic status in masked language model predictions.
Evaluating disparagement and dehumanization using identity terms in hate speech detection tasks.
Assessing stereotypical associations related to physical appearance via identity terms in masked language model predictions.
